finalOutput:
Delivered `effect_gouraud_shaded_cube_ollama-mimo-v2.6-flash-rl-mxfp4_01.html` — a single self-contained file using only Canvas 2D.

**Pipeline implemented:**
- 8 cube vertices, 6 quad faces split into 12 triangles
- Model rotation via combined 3×3 matrix (Rz·Ry·Rx)
- Perspective projection (60° FOV, focal length from canvas height)
- Backface culling using view-space normal vs. centroid-to-camera vector
- Per-vertex Lambert lighting from an orbiting point light (with distance attenuation)
- Software rasterizer writing to a `Uint32Array` framebuffer with a depth buffer, interpolating RGB linearly across each scanline (Gouraud shading)

**Controls:**
- `W` — wireframe toggle (draws edges + vertex dots over the shaded render)
- `P` — pause/resume rotation and light motion
- `R` — reset rotation

**HUD:** live FPS (smoothed), wireframe/pause state, triangle count, renderer label. The moving light is visualized as a glowing sprite in screen space.
